info.name: Hospigo 7d staff and roles
info.description: Step 7d (API): staff list, add, change, switch off and on, roles and permissions, the staff code format and My profile for every role. BEFORE RUNNING: (1) npm run prisma:migrate -w @hospigo/api  (2) re-run the dev seed so the roles get the new permission list: NODE_ENV=development npm run prisma:seed -w @hospigo/api  (3) restart the API on port 3000. Select the Hospigo Local environment (staffPassword and superadminPassword), then Run collection. It adds ONE test role (Postman 7d role) and ONE test person (pm7d.test@demo-north.example.test), switched OFF at the end; later runs reuse them, so nothing piles up. The staff code format is put back. Nothing is deleted anywhere. The email code flows that need a real mailbox are proven in the automated tests; here only the refusals are checked. About 3 logins count against the login IP limit (20 per minute).

item.name: 0 Setup
1 Login SuperAdmin (north)

exec: pm.test('select the Hospigo Local environment: staffPassword and superadminPassword must be set', () => { pm.expect(pm.variables.get('staffPassword'), 'staffPassword').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(pm.variables.get('superadminPassword'), 'superadminPassword').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

item.name: 2 Login Receptionist (north main)
3 Login SuperAdmin (south)
1 Staff list and options
4 Receptionist cannot list staff (403)
5 No token = 401
6 SuperAdmin reads the options: roles, branches, code format, limits

exec: pm.test('both system roles are offered and assignable to a SuperAdmin', () => { const codes = j.roles.map(r => r.code); pm.expect(codes).to.include('SUPER_ADMIN'); pm.expect(codes).to.include('BRANCH_ADMIN'); pm.expect(j.roles.find(r => r.code === 'BRANCH_ADMIN').assignable).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 7 SuperAdmin lists staff: every row has a status, branches, roles and who may be changed

exec: pm.test('every row is complete', () => j.items.forEach(s => { pm.expect(s.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(['ACTIVE','INVITED','INACTIVE']).to.include(s.status); pm.expect(s.branches).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(s.roles).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(s.editable).to.be.a('boolean'); pm.expect(s).to.not.have.property('passwordHash'); }));
pm.test('exactly one row is me', () => pm.expect(j.items.filter(s => s.isYou).length).to.eql(1));

item.name: 8 Search by text and filter by status

exec: pm.test('only matching active people', () => { pm.expect(j.items.length).to.be.at.least(1); j.items.forEach(s => { pm.expect(s.status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); pm.expect((s.name + s.email + s.code).toLowerCase()).to.include('superadmin'); }); });

item.name: 9 A silly page size does not break the list (capped)

exec: pm.test('capped and defaulted', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.pageSize).to.be.at.most(100); pm.expect(j.page).to.eql(1); });

item.name: 10 The other hospital never sees north staff
2 Staff code format
11 Receptionist cannot read it (403)
12 SuperAdmin changes prefix and digits; the sample follows

exec: pm.test('prefix is upper case and the next code has 4 digits', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.prefix).to.eql('PM7'); pm.expect(j.next).to.match(/^PM7\d{4,}$/); });

item.name: 13 A bad prefix is refused (400 prefix)

exec: pm.test('names the field', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.code).to.eql('SETTINGS_INVALID'); pm.expect(j.field).to.eql('prefix'); });

item.name: 14 Digits out of range are refused (400 minWidth)
15 Receptionist cannot change it (403)
3 Roles
16 Receptionist cannot list roles (403)
17 SuperAdmin lists roles: the two system roles are there; finds the test role if an earlier run made it

exec: pm.test('canWrite and both system roles', () => { pm.expect(j.canWrite).to.eql(true); const sys = j.items.filter(r => r.isSystem).map(r => r.code); pm.expect(sys).to.include('SUPER_ADMIN'); pm.expect(sys).to.include('BRANCH_ADMIN'); });
pm.test('each role says how many hold it and its permissions', () => j.items.forEach(r => { pm.expect(r.assignedCount).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(r.permissionCodes).to.be.an('array'); }));
const mine = j.items.find(r => r.name === 'Postman 7d role'); pm.collectionVariables.set('rId', mine ? mine.id : '');

item.name: 18 Catalog: every permission has a plain description and a group

exec: pm.test('described', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.items.length).to.be.at.least(10); j.items.forEach(p => { pm.expect(p.description).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(p.group).to.be.a('string'); }); });

item.name: 19 Ready-made roles to start from

exec: pm.test('Receptionist, Nurse and Doctor', () => { const keys = pm.response.json().items.map(t => t.key); pm.expect(keys).to.include.members(['RECEPTIONIST','NURSE','DOCTOR']); });

item.name: 20 SuperAdmin makes a role (or it already exists from an earlier run)

exec: pm.test('201 the first time, 400 name DUPLICATE afterwards', () => { if (pm.collectionVariables.get('rId')) { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().field).to.eql('name'); pm.expect(pm.response.json().reason).to.eql('DUPLICATE'); } else { pm.response.to.have.status(201); } });

item.name: 21 Receptionist cannot make a role (403)
22 A permission code that does not exist is refused
23 A role with no permission is refused
24 SuperAdmin changes the role (name stays, description and powers change)

exec: pm.test('changed', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.description).to.eql('Changed by the 7d collection'); pm.expect(j.permissionCodes).to.include('patients.registry.read'); });

item.name: 25 A system role cannot be changed (409 SYSTEM_ROLE)
26 The other hospital cannot touch this role (404)
27 Receptionist cannot change a role (403)
4 Add, change, switch off and on
28 Find the test person from an earlier run

exec: const mine = pm.response.json().items.find(s => s.email === 'pm7d.test@demo-north.example.test'); pm.collectionVariables.set('sId', mine ? mine.id : '');

item.name: 29 SuperAdmin adds a person with the test role (or the person exists from an earlier run)

exec: pm.test('201 the first time, 400 email DUPLICATE afterwards (any letter case)', () => { if (pm.collectionVariables.get('sId')) { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().reason).to.eql('DUPLICATE'); } else { pm.response.to.have.status(201); } });

if (pm.response.code === 201) { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('sId', j.staff.id); pm.test('invited, with a code in the chosen format, email stored in lower case', () => { pm.expect(j.staff.status).to.eql('INVITED'); pm.expect(j.staff.code).to.match(/^PM7\d{4,}$/); pm.expect(j.staff.email).to.eql('pm7d.test@demo-north.example.test'); pm.expect(j.activationSent).to.be.a('boolean'); pm.expect(j.staff).to.not.have.property('passwordHash'); }); }

item.name: 30 Receptionist cannot add staff (403)
31 A person with no branch is refused
32 A person with no role is refused
33 A bad email is refused
34 A branch of the other hospital is refused
35 Switch the test person on (it may be off from an earlier run)

exec: pm.test('200, or 409 ALREADY_ACTIVE', () => { if (pm.response.code === 409) { pm.expect(pm.response.json().reason).to.eql('ALREADY_ACTIVE'); } else { pm.response.to.have.status(200); } });

item.name: 36 SuperAdmin changes the person: name, phone, branches and roles together

exec: pm.test('changed', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.name).to.eql('Postman Seven D Two'); pm.expect(j.phone).to.eql('+91 98765 43210'); pm.expect(j.roles.map(r => r.roleId)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('rId')); });

item.name: 37 Branches without roles are refused (they must be sent together)
38 Send the activation email again (only before a password is set)

exec: pm.test('200, or 429 when run again within a minute', () => { if (pm.response.code === 429) { pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('RATE_LIMITED'); pm.expect(pm.response.json().retryAfterSec).to.be.a('number'); } else { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().activationSent).to.be.a('boolean'); } });

item.name: 39 Receptionist cannot change the person (403)
40 The other hospital cannot reach the person (404)
41 The other hospital cannot switch the person off (404)
42 Nobody can switch themselves off (409 SELF)

exec: const me = pm.response.json().items.find(s => s.isYou); pm.collectionVariables.set('meId', me.id); pm.test('found myself', () => pm.expect(me).to.exist);

item.name: 43 Switch myself off is refused
44 Change my own roles through Staff is refused
45 A role people still hold cannot be switched off (409 ROLE_IN_USE)
46 Switch the test person off (cleanup: signed out, nothing deleted)
47 A switched-off person cannot be sent an activation email (409 INACTIVE)
48 The list shows them as switched off, and they are still there

exec: pm.test('there', () => { const s = pm.response.json().items.find(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('sId')); pm.expect(s).to.exist; pm.expect(s.status).to.eql('INACTIVE'); });

item.name: 5 My profile (every role)
49 No token = 401
50 SuperAdmin reads their own account

exec: pm.test('my own data only', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.email).to.eql(pm.variables.get('superEmail')); pm.expect(j.roles).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j.limits.nameMax).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(j).to.not.have.property('passwordHash'); pm.collectionVariables.set('origName', j.name); pm.collectionVariables.set('origPhone', j.phone === null ? '' : j.phone); });

item.name: 51 The receptionist reads theirs too (not only doctors)
52 Change my own name and phone (tidied)

exec: pm.test('tidied', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.name).to.eql('Postman Me'); pm.expect(j.phone).to.eql('+91 98765 00000'); });

item.name: 53 Put my name and phone back
54 I cannot change my email, code or anyone else through this call
55 A bad phone number is refused
56 Email change: a bad address is refused, nothing is sent
57 Email change: the address I already use is refused (SAME)
58 Email change: an address another person uses is refused (DUPLICATE)
59 Email change: a code nobody asked for does not work (EXPIRED)

exec: pm.test('OTP_INVALID', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.code).to.eql('OTP_INVALID'); pm.expect(j.reason).to.eql('EXPIRED'); });

item.name: 60 Password change: the address typed must be my own (MISMATCH)
61 Password change: a code nobody asked for does not work (EXPIRED)

exec: pm.test('OTP_INVALID', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.code).to.eql('OTP_INVALID'); pm.expect(j.reason).to.eql('EXPIRED'); });

item.name: 62 Password change: a weak password is refused before the code is used
63 Staff admin routes need the token kind too: no token on /roles = 401
6 Put things back
64 Staff code format back to what it was
